text.content:
Echo is an internal extraordinary power source, interpreted as psionics, biotics, paracausality, or another setting-appropriate force.

Echo is available to Broken, Resonant, Stray, and Primus. Broken and Resonant are volatile Echo users with lower maximums and stronger in-scene generation; Stray and Primus are reservoirs with deeper pools that usually recover through rest.

daggerheartSpace.source: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind
